acceptedAnswer.text: No. Every shower is sold as the cedar unit on its own, so you can use hardware you already have. Add our Premium Shower Hardware for a stainless rain head, hand shower and hot and cold mixing valve.
Not for a cold rinse: the Sunlight, Sierra and Savannah connect to a standard garden hose. For hot and cold water through the premium hardware, a licensed plumber may be needed.
Drain the lines and hardware fully before freezing weather. The cedar can stay outside year-round; leave it to weather to silver-grey or keep the colour with an exterior oil.
The Sunlight, Cloudburst, Rainbow Barrel and Skylight are Western red cedar, in knotty or clear grade. The Sierra and Savannah are Eastern White Cedar from the Canadian Timber Collection.

items.alt: Sunlight cedar pillar outdoor shower with premium hardware, The Toronto Sauna Co.
items.d: A slim cedar pillar shower for quick rinses beside your sauna, hot tub or pool.

items.alt: Sierra white cedar pillar outdoor shower, The Toronto Sauna Co.
items.d: Our Canadian Timber pillar shower in Eastern White Cedar: the same slim, easy-to-place design as the Sunlight, in light, tight-knot white cedar.

items.alt: Savannah white cedar privacy panel outdoor shower with rain head, The Toronto Sauna Co.
items.d: A wider take on the pillar: a 42" Eastern White Cedar privacy panel on a 40" × 40" deck, for a little more screening and room to rinse off.

items.alt: Cloudburst enclosed cedar outdoor shower with door, The Toronto Sauna Co.
items.d: A fully enclosed cedar shower with a modern slatted privacy wall and a self-closing door on stainless steel hinges.

items.alt: Rainbow Barrel cedar outdoor shower, The Toronto Sauna Co.
items.d: A round cedar barrel shower with an open doorway: 60" across and 80" tall, in Western red cedar with stainless steel bands.

items.alt: Skylight cedar barrel washroom and shower combo with acrylic dome, The Toronto Sauna Co.
items.d: A 7' cedar barrel divided into a washroom and a shower, under a clear acrylic skylight dome.

blocks.html: Rinse off between sauna rounds, after the lake or out of the pool. Pillar, privacy-panel, enclosed and barrel showers in red or white cedar. Buy the shower on its own, or add our premium hot and cold hardware.

blocks.html: A quick rinse before your plunge keeps the water cleaner, and a cool shower between sauna rounds is the classic Finnish way to reset. Our showers are cedar, like our saunas and plunges, so the whole setup matches.
